query:
INSERT INTO seller_profile_research_runs (
            profile_id,
            organization_id,
            workflow_run_id,
            trigger,
            status,
            requested_by_user_id,
            requested_at,
            started_at,
            metadata
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3,
            $4,
            'RUNNING'::seller_profile_research_run_status,
            $5,
            to_timestamp(($6::double precision) / 1000.0),
            now(),
            $7::jsonb
         )
         RETURNING id
